source_code_scope: All 193 Lean files, the checker and the fixed v1.0.0 tag are unchanged; this commit publishes the final manuscript and updates publication documentation.
paper_distribution: The final manuscript PDF and TeX and the sealed alignment supplement are included in paper/ on the main branch.
supplement_verification: Extract the supplement outside the code checkout. Its verifier requires a separate checkout of fixed_code_commit or its bundled fixed-code-source.zip, with the pinned dependencies; it is not a verifier for the new main commit.
supplement_snapshot: Sealed pre-publication snapshot, copied byte for byte; its publication-status fields describe the time of that snapshot.

historical_baseline.note: Historical hashes and source-line references do not identify the current final manuscript.
